schema:
CREATE TABLE TeamMembers (team_id INTEGER, member_id INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (team_id, member_id), FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES Members(member_id));
CREATE TABLE Members (member_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenure_years INTEGER CHECK (tenure_years >= 0));
correct_query: SELECT t.team_id, ROUND(AVG(m.tenure_years), 2) AS avg_tenure FROM TeamMembers AS t INNER JOIN Members AS m ON t.member_id = m.member_id GROUP BY t.team_id
